summary: Shows how to expose Kafka JMX metrics and send them with Grafana Alloy to Grafana Cloud, then use the Kafka integration dashboards and alerts.

needs.description: Running Kafka cluster with JMX remote access enabled on brokers, root access to configure it.
needs.evidence: Before you begin: "A Kafka cluster up and running"; configure-jmx-exporter

needs.description: Machine with admin privileges to install Grafana Alloy, with network access to broker JMX ports.
needs.evidence: Before you begin: Alloy host with network access to JMX ports

needs.description: Kafka integration page /connections/add-new-connection/kafka available on the stack (Alloy token generation, dashboard and alert install).
kafka_* metrics in Cloud Prometheus (e.g. kafka_server_*) for the Explore metric picker and dashboards.
